title: SEC拟推ETF新规16万亿美元市场震动保密申请引争议
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Isabel, you reported on this, you interviewed him.
segments.zh: 伊莎贝尔，你报道了这件事，采访了他。

segments.en: Probably the more accurate use of the word exclusive.
segments.zh: 可能用“独家”这个词更准确。

segments.en: What did you learn? No, you also got an exclusive. We can both get an exclusive.
segments.zh: 你学到了什么？不，你也拿到了独家。我们都可以有独家。

segments.en: So basically, we had a chat with Brian after he did the podcast with Eric.
segments.zh: 基本上，布赖恩和埃里克做完播客后，我们聊了聊。

segments.en: I literally picked him up from the podcast through. And then they released this request for comment.
segments.zh: 我直接从播客现场接上他，然后他们发布了这份征求意见稿。

segments.en: And it basically asked for two things. Number one is to give issuers greater confidentiality when they file.
segments.zh: 主要问了两件事：第一，给予发行人更大的保密性。

segments.en: Katie and I know this, we have a group chat where we paste every single ETF filing.
segments.zh: 凯蒂和我有个群聊，我们会贴出每一份ETF申请。

segments.en: And honestly, sometimes when you see one unique one, minute after, you see another one.
segments.zh: 说实话，有时刚看到一个独特的申请，下一秒又出现另一个。

segments.en: And it's kind of amazing to see. And I guess that's what they're thinking of trying to avoid because it really is, like Brian Daily said,
segments.zh: 这挺有意思的。我想他们正试图避免这种情况，因为正如布赖恩·戴利所说，这是一场激烈的模仿竞赛。

segments.en: it's a ferocious copycat race. And the second one is whether they should have additional tools in their toolbox to really intervene after a fund launches
segments.zh: 第二，他们是否应该拥有更多工具，在基金推出后进行干预。

segments.en: because now they only have suspension, which they said is a little bit extreme.
segments.zh: 因为目前他们只有暂停这一选项，他们认为这有点极端。

segments.en: And you don't want to just suspend right left. So the one thing I think people may not fully understand is that when an ETF issuer file files paperwork,
segments.zh: 而且你不能随意暂停。有一点大家可能不完全理解：当ETF发行商提交文件时，

segments.en: it's not like the SEC formally accepts it or rejects it, right?
segments.zh: 并非SEC正式批准或拒绝，对吧？

segments.en: They just kind of look at the paperwork and sometimes things can go off of that and just launch regardless.
segments.zh: 他们只是看看文件，有时文件没问题就直接发行了。

segments.en: Generally, it launches after 75 days. We always go to the Bloomberg intelligence guys, Eric, James, and Athanasis.
segments.zh: 通常75天后发行。我们常咨询彭博情报团队，Eric、James和Athanasis。

segments.en: And we're like, is this already a green light? And they're like, no comment basically means it's good news.
segments.zh: 我们问：这是绿灯了吗？他们回答：不评论基本就是好消息。

segments.en: And basically, it means it's effective.
